hook.name: MidasGoldHook
hook.description: ERC-20/ERC-20 pool hook that collects a fixed fee always denominated in currency0. For zeroForOne swaps the fee is deducted from the input in beforeSwap; for oneForZero swaps it is deducted from the currency0 output in afterSwap. Only exact-input swaps are supported. The fee rate and recipient are immutable at deployment, and the hook only permits the fixed token pair set at construction.
